about: Real shopper requests for Shop Counter (Satechi, Roborock). Each case: what the shopper said, the tool calls a good assistant makes (steps), what the server must answer (expect), and what the no-LLM router must pick (router). Traps come from a live shop-assistant bot (TT Bot). Facts are audited against the raw store feed on every answer. Runner: evals/run.mjs. Round 2 (2026-10-12): x-* cases cover the shopper-owned closet across stores, auth-* cases the signed session. Round 3 (2026-10-13): hon-* cases cover compatibility by meaning for models outside the device dictionary (model prefixes, "only", "upgraded from", series, + editions, a robot is not an accessory).
